entities.name: Victor Oehrn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Victor Otto Oehrn was a Fregattenkapitän with the Kriegsmarine during World War II. He commanded the U-boats U-14 and U-37, sinking twenty-four ships on four patrols, for a total of 104,846 tons of Allied shipping.
